For us, LG has always meant trust and durability.
Back in 2004, we purchased an LG 1.5 Ton Window AC for our home. Even after more than 22 years, it is still running well and is being used daily by my father in our village. That kind of reliability is truly remarkable.
Now, I would love to replace it with a new LG Window AC for my father. As a long-time and happy LG customer, it would be wonderful if LG could help us continue this journey.
Thank you, LG, for building products that stand the test of time. ❤️
